# YB Marketing (Yakima Branding)

> YB Marketing is a digital marketing agency based in Yakima, Washington since 2004. We help businesses across the United States with SEO, AI search optimization, Google Ads, website design, branding, social media, content, and AI tools for business.

- Phone: (509) 901-9735
- Email: info@yakimabranding.com
- Office: Yakima, Washington, USA. Fully remote team working with clients nationwide by phone, Zoom, and email.
- Rating: 5.0 from 48 Google reviews
- Founded: 2004
- Languages: English site, with a Spanish version at https://yakimabranding.com/es
- Full page text for AI assistants: https://yakimabranding.com/llms-full.txt

## Services

- [Search Engine Optimization Services](https://yakimabranding.com/seo): YB Marketing provides expert SEO services for businesses in Yakima and across the country, helping businesses rank higher and get found online. Call 509-901-9735 for a free site review.
- [Local SEO Services for Contractors & Service Businesses](https://yakimabranding.com/seo/local-seo): Help customers in your service area find your business on Google Maps and in local search. Local SEO services with clear reporting on rankings and leads.
- [AI Search Optimization Services (GEO)](https://yakimabranding.com/seo/ai-search): Improve how your business appears in ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and other AI search experiences with a strategy built on strong SEO fundamentals.
- [Technical SEO Services & Website Audits](https://yakimabranding.com/seo/technical-seo): Find and fix technical website issues affecting search visibility, including indexing errors, slow pages, redirects, duplicate content, and site structure.
- [Website Migration SEO Services](https://yakimabranding.com/seo/website-migration): Redesigning your website, changing domains, or moving platforms? Protect existing search visibility with URL mapping, redirects, launch checks, and post launch monitoring.
- [Google Ads Management Services](https://yakimabranding.com/google-ads): YB Marketing creates and manages Google Ads campaigns that drive real results for businesses across the country. Ready to stop wasting ad spend? Call 509-901-9735.
- [Website Design & Development](https://yakimabranding.com/web-design): YB Marketing builds custom WordPress sites and Wix websites tailored to your aesthetic, features, and budget. Ready for a website that converts? Call 509-901-9735 to get started.
- [Branding & Logo Design Services](https://yakimabranding.com/branding): YB Marketing designs complete branding and graphics packages, including logos, brand identity, and visual systems, for businesses across the country. Ready for a brand that stands out? Call 509-901-9735.
- [Social Media Management Services](https://yakimabranding.com/social-media): YB Marketing grows your Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn following with planned, on-brand content and measurable results. Ready to grow your audience? Call 509-901-9735.
- [Content Creation & Blogging](https://yakimabranding.com/content-marketing): YB Marketing crafts SEO-friendly, high-quality content that captivates readers and ranks well in search results. Want content that works harder for your business? Call 509-901-9735.
- [Press Release Writing & Distribution](https://yakimabranding.com/press-releases): YB Marketing writes and distributes press releases for new hires, expansions, and product launches, keeping your business in the news. Ready to announce your next milestone? Call 509-901-9735.
- [Customer Growth & Communication Tool](https://yakimabranding.com/customer-growth): Organize every lead, centralize every conversation, and automate follow-up with YB Marketing's Customer Growth & Communication Tool: CRM, messaging, and automation for growing businesses.
